_provenance: New 2026-10-21 authoring text based on IN2 Sonoda source notes and HOSHIMI_INNAI_NURSE_ENSEMBLE_CHARACTER_BIBLE; not original game quotations.

nurse_station.zh_CN: 交班资料我整理好啦。手术部要的那份放在最上面。
nurse_station.en: The handover papers are organized. I put the copy for the surgical unit right on top.

nurse_station.zh_CN: 刚才有位患者按铃说睡不着，我去听她说了一会儿。现在她安心多了。
nurse_station.en: A patient rang because she could not sleep. I sat and listened for a while, and she seems more at ease now.

nurse_station.zh_CN: 弘子前辈那份记录我核对过了。她写得清楚，接班的人也省心。
nurse_station.en: I checked Hiroko’s notes. They are clear, which makes things much easier for the next shift.

nurse_station.zh_CN: 下一班快到了。我会把患者在意的小事也交代清楚，不会只交数字。
nurse_station.en: The next shift is nearly here. I will pass on the little things the patients are worried about, not just the numbers.

ward_nurse.zh_CN: 她今天终于肯把担心的事说出来了。我先听完，再和大家确认需要怎么做。
ward_nurse.en: She finally told me what has been worrying her. I listened first, and now I will check with the team about what we can do.

ward_nurse.zh_CN: 术前准备的记录在这里。完成的我打了勾，剩下的也写清楚了。
ward_nurse.en: Here is the preoperative preparation record. I checked off what is done and noted what is still pending.

ward_nurse.zh_CN: 她说不想一个人等太久。我会确认接下来是谁陪她，不能光说一句“马上”。
ward_nurse.en: She does not want to wait alone for too long. I will check who is staying with her next instead of just saying “soon.”

ward_nurse.zh_CN: 这位患者需要再听一遍说明。没关系，我再讲一次；她听懂了我们才往下走。
ward_nurse.en: This patient needs the explanation again. That is fine—I will go through it once more before we move on.

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 器械清点完成。坂口医生，台上已经准备好了。
scrub_nurse.en: The instrument count is complete, Doctor Sakaguchi. The sterile table is ready.

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 缝线和持针器我分开放好了，需要时告诉我。
scrub_nurse.en: I placed the sutures and needle holders separately. Let me know when you need them.

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 这一件给您。我把下一个步骤要用的器械也摆在顺手的位置。
scrub_nurse.en: Here you are. I have placed the instruments for the next step within easy reach.

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 标本交给巡回护士核对了。我继续负责台上器械。
scrub_nurse.en: I handed the specimen to the circulating nurse for verification. I will stay on the sterile field.

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 台面稍微有点挤。我重新整理一下，清点记录不受影响。
scrub_nurse.en: The table is a little crowded. I will reorganize it without disturbing the instrument count.

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 巡回记录已经开始了，监护我也在看。
circulating_nurse.en: The circulating record is underway, and I am watching the monitors too.

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 备用耗材补好了。台上还需要什么，直接告诉我。
circulating_nurse.en: The spare supplies are restocked. Let me know if the sterile team needs anything else.

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 标本和标记我核对好了，会按流程送出去。
circulating_nurse.en: I checked the specimen and its label. I will send it out through the usual process.

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 重要时间点都记下来了。坂口医生，您专心做台上的事。
circulating_nurse.en: I have logged all the key times, Doctor Sakaguchi. You can stay focused on the operation.

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 外侧设备已经确认。等手术结束，我再核对一次转运安排。
circulating_nurse.en: The equipment outside the sterile field is checked. I will confirm the transfer plan again when the operation ends.

ward_nurse.zh_CN: 病房准备交给我吧。我会把患者关心的问题也一并交接清楚。
ward_nurse.en: I will handle the ward preparation. I will also make sure the patient’s concerns are passed on.

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 好，我上器械位。清点和递械我负责，坂口医生放心。
scrub_nurse.en: All right, I will take the scrub position. I will handle the counts and instruments, Doctor Sakaguchi.

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 巡回是吧？交给我！监护、记录和外围协调我都会看好。
circulating_nurse.en: Circulating nurse? Leave it to me! I will watch the monitors, records, and coordination outside the sterile field.

post_operation_replies.zh_CN: 完成啦！患者的交接我会继续跟进，大家辛苦了。
post_operation_replies.en: All finished! I will follow through with the patient handover. Good work, everyone.

post_operation_replies.zh_CN: 器械和记录都核对过了。辛苦了，坂口医生；我去确认患者的下一步安排。
post_operation_replies.en: The instruments and records are checked. Good work, Doctor Sakaguchi. I will confirm the patient’s next steps.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血压比刚才低了。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the blood pressure has dropped.

2.zh_CN: 血压还没回稳，我一直看着监护。
2.en: The pressure has not stabilized. I am keeping an eye on the monitor.

3.zh_CN: 血压还是偏低，我又核对了一遍。
3.en: The blood pressure is still low. I checked it again.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血压突然掉得很快！
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the blood pressure is falling rapidly!

2.zh_CN: 血压还在掉，监护读数没有回升！
2.en: The pressure is still falling; the monitor readings have not recovered!

3.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血压仍然没有稳住！
3.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the blood pressure still has not stabilized!

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血压升上去了。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the blood pressure has gone up.

2.zh_CN: 血压仍然偏高，我继续核对读数。
2.en: The pressure is still high. I am continuing to check the readings.

3.zh_CN: 还没有回落，血压仍然高于刚才。
3.en: It has not come down; the pressure remains higher than before.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血压突然升得很高！
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the blood pressure has risen sharply!

2.zh_CN: 血压还是很高，变化没有停下来！
2.en: The pressure remains very high; it has not settled!

3.zh_CN: 监护还显示明显高血压，坂口医生！
3.en: The monitor still shows markedly elevated blood pressure, Doctor Sakaguchi!

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心率正在加快。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the heart rate is increasing.

2.zh_CN: 心率还是偏快，我在继续监看。
2.en: The heart rate is still fast. I am monitoring it closely.

3.zh_CN: 心率没有回到刚才的水平。
3.en: The heart rate has not returned to its earlier level.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心率突然冲上去了！
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the heart rate has suddenly shot up!

2.zh_CN: 心率仍然很快，没有缓下来！
2.en: The heart rate remains very fast. It has not slowed!

3.zh_CN: 心率还是过快，坂口医生！
3.en: The heart rate is still too fast, Doctor Sakaguchi!

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心率往下走了。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the heart rate is dropping.

2.zh_CN: 心率还是偏慢，我重新看过了。
2.en: The heart rate is still slow. I checked again.

3.zh_CN: 监护显示心率仍然没有回稳。
3.en: The monitor shows the heart rate has not stabilized yet.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心率突然掉得很低！
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the heart rate has dropped very low!

2.zh_CN: 心率还在往下，情况没有缓和！
2.en: The heart rate is still falling. It has not improved!

3.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心率仍然很低！
3.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the heart rate is still very low!

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，监护上的心律不规则。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the rhythm on the monitor is irregular.

2.zh_CN: 心律还是不规则，我在继续确认。
2.en: The rhythm is still irregular. I am continuing to check.

3.zh_CN: 节律还没恢复，监护仍然显示异常。
3.en: The rhythm has not returned to normal; the monitor still shows an abnormality.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心律突然乱得很明显！
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the cardiac rhythm has suddenly become very irregular!

3.zh_CN: 监护上的节律仍然很乱，坂口医生！
3.en: The rhythm on the monitor remains highly irregular, Doctor Sakaguchi!

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血氧开始往下降了。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, oxygen saturation is starting to fall.

2.zh_CN: 血氧还没有回升，我继续盯着。
2.en: Oxygen saturation has not recovered. I am watching it closely.

3.zh_CN: 血氧仍然偏低，我又确认了监护。
3.en: Oxygen saturation remains low. I checked the monitor again.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血氧掉得很快！
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, oxygen saturation is falling quickly!

2.en: Oxygen saturation is still very low. It has not improved!

3.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血氧仍然没有稳住！
3.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, oxygen saturation still has not stabilized!

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，呼吸状态有点不稳定。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the respiratory status is becoming unstable.

2.zh_CN: 呼吸状态还不稳，我在继续监看。
2.en: Respiratory status is still unstable. I am continuing to monitor it.

3.zh_CN: 呼吸方面的异常仍然没有消失。
3.en: The respiratory abnormality is still present.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，呼吸状态突然明显恶化！
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, respiratory status has suddenly deteriorated!

2.zh_CN: 呼吸监护还是很不稳定！
2.en: The respiratory monitoring is still highly unstable!

3.zh_CN: 坂口医生，呼吸异常还在持续！
3.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the respiratory abnormality is still continuing!

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，监护上的状态出现变化了。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the monitor readings are changing.

2.zh_CN: 我又确认过了，监护仍然不稳定。
2.en: I checked again. The monitor readings are still unstable.

3.zh_CN: 患者状态还没回稳，我会继续报告变化。
3.en: The patient’s condition has not stabilized. I will keep reporting any changes.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，监护上出现了明显异常！
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the monitor shows a major abnormal change!

2.zh_CN: 异常还在持续，状态没有恢复！
2.en: The abnormal readings are continuing. The condition has not recovered!

3.zh_CN: 坂口医生，患者状态仍然不稳定！
3.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the patient’s condition remains unstable!

crisis_attempt_mapping.severity_source: existing runtime severe/nonsevere; normal and severe are authoring labels; never derive severity from attempt count
crisis_attempt_mapping.attempt_index: 1=crisis initially displayed; 2=first handling failed; 3=second handling failed; after 3rd failure use existing abort
crisis_attempt_mapping.caller: assigned circulating nurse; do not trigger from scrub nurse if another named circulating nurse is present
crisis_attempt_mapping.fallback: actor flavor+severity+attempt -> actor flavor+severity+attempt1 -> generic_instability same severity+attempt -> global fallback

next_test_hint.zh_CN: 坂口医生，我想再确认一项检查。她刚才说的那个不舒服，我有点在意。
next_test_hint.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, I would like to check one more thing. Something she said about her discomfort is on my mind.

next_test_hint.zh_CN: 现在下结论可能还早。先把剩下那项检查做好，好吗？
next_test_hint.en: It may be a little early to decide. Could we finish that remaining examination first?

insufficient_evidence.zh_CN: 我觉得资料还差一点。让患者再回答几个问题，会不会更稳妥？
insufficient_evidence.en: I do not think we have quite enough information. Could we ask the patient a few more questions?

insufficient_evidence.zh_CN: 检查结果还没对齐，我想再确认一下。
insufficient_evidence.en: The findings do not quite line up yet. I would like to check again.

sufficient_evidence.zh_CN: 嗯，资料已经齐了。坂口医生，现在可以由您来判断了。
sufficient_evidence.en: Yes, the information is complete. Doctor Sakaguchi, I think you can make the decision now.

sufficient_evidence.zh_CN: 刚才担心的地方也核对好了，结果已经足够支持您的判断。
sufficient_evidence.en: We checked the point that concerned me. The findings should now be enough for your assessment.

diagnosis_correct_reply.zh_CN: 太好了，检查结果和判断一致！我去把后续护理安排跟患者说明白。
diagnosis_correct_reply.en: Great, the findings match the diagnosis! I will explain the follow-up care plan to the patient.

diagnosis_correct_reply.zh_CN: 嗯，这就说得通了。患者刚才还在担心，我去告诉她下一步怎么安排。
diagnosis_correct_reply.en: That makes sense now. The patient was still worried; I will explain what happens next.

diagnosis_incorrect_reply.zh_CN: 坂口医生，等等。她刚才描述的情况和这个结论好像还对不上，我们再看一遍好吗？
diagnosis_incorrect_reply.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, one moment. What she described does not quite match this conclusion. Could we review it again?

diagnosis_incorrect_reply.zh_CN: 这一项检查结果让我有点在意。我们先重新核对，再向患者解释好吗？
diagnosis_incorrect_reply.en: One of these findings concerns me. Could we check it again before explaining the conclusion to the patient?

chatter.zh_CN: 她刚才说睡不好，不一定是疼。我想先问问她是不是担心明天的安排。
chatter.en: She said she did not sleep well. It may not be pain; I want to ask whether tomorrow’s schedule is worrying her.

chatter.zh_CN: 坂口医生，患者问得很仔细呢。我挺高兴的，问清楚总比一个人担心好。
chatter.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, that patient is asking detailed questions. I am glad she is; it is better than worrying alone.

chatter.zh_CN: 今天病房里有人终于愿意笑了。就一点点，不过我看见了。
chatter.en: Someone in the ward finally smiled today. Just a little, but I noticed it.

clinic_support.zh_CN: 检查用的东西已经准备好了。我会先向患者说明要做什么。
clinic_support.en: The examination supplies are ready. I will explain what we are about to do to the patient.

clinic_support.zh_CN: 她对这项检查有疑问。我先把问题记下来，让她直接问您。
clinic_support.en: She has a question about this examination. I wrote it down so she can ask you directly.

clinic_support.zh_CN: 门诊记录我补齐了，患者问过的几个问题也写在后面。
clinic_support.en: The clinic record is complete. I also noted the questions the patient asked.

preop_support.zh_CN: 术前准备都按记录核对过了。她还有一点紧张，我已经把问题传给负责的团队。
preop_support.en: I checked the preoperative preparations against the record. She is still a little nervous, so I passed her questions to the team.

preop_support.zh_CN: 需要交接的事情都写好了，包括患者想提前知道的步骤。
preop_support.en: I have written down everything for handover, including the steps the patient wanted explained in advance.

personal_nurse_dialogue._note: Next-test hints and sufficiency checks MUST obey existing always-correct nurse advice resolver. Correct/incorrect responses are POST player diagnosis only; no nurse names a disease or introduces extra error probability.

station_idle.zh_CN: 愛実一边整理交班本，一边笑着说：「这位患者怕麻烦别人，问什么都说没事。还好后来愿意告诉我她真正担心的事。」
station_idle.en: Itsumi tidies the handover log and smiles. “That patient hated feeling like a bother and kept saying she was fine. I am glad she finally told me what was really worrying her.”

station_idle.zh_CN: 愛実把便签夹进记录板：「我喜欢热闹，可交班还是要讲清楚。下一个班可没有时间猜我在说谁。」
station_idle.en: Itsumi slips a note into her clipboard. “I like a lively shift, but handovers need to be clear. The next team should not have to guess who I am talking about.”

station_idle.zh_CN: 愛実朝远处打了个招呼，又转向坂口：「前辈们做事真快。我也不是只会跑腿哦，刚才那份病历已经核对好了。」
station_idle.en: Itsumi waves to a colleague, then turns to Sakaguchi. “The senior nurses are so quick. But I do more than run errands—I just finished checking that chart myself.”

ward_idle.zh_CN: 愛実轻轻合上病房门：「她没有哪里更疼，只是睡不着。我陪她聊了几句，等会儿再来看看。」
ward_idle.en: Itsumi gently closes the ward door. “Her pain is not worse; she just cannot sleep. I talked with her for a bit and will check on her again later.”

ward_idle.zh_CN: 愛実拿着护理记录微笑：「她今天第一次主动问什么时候可以回家。能开始想出院以后的事，是件好事吧。」
ward_idle.en: Itsumi smiles over the nursing notes. “She asked for the first time when she might go home. Thinking about life after discharge is a good sign, isn’t it?”

ward_idle.zh_CN: 愛実俯身把床旁的呼叫按钮摆近些：「需要我就按铃呀。别担心会不会打扰我，工作不就是这个嘛。」
ward_idle.en: Itsumi bends to place the call button within reach. “Ring if you need me. Do not worry about bothering me—that is what I am here for.”

lounge_idle.zh_CN: 愛実把水杯放下，伸了个懒腰。「每次说只休息五分钟，聊着聊着就过了。今天不行，我还有一件事想亲自处理完呢。」
lounge_idle.en: Itsumi sets her cup down and stretches. “I always say I will rest for just five minutes, then I start chatting. Not today—I still have something I want to finish myself.”

lounge_idle.zh_CN: 愛実翻着一本普通杂志，忽然笑起来。「弘子前辈连休息时都像很可靠的前辈。……嗯？我可不是每句话都要提她啦！」
lounge_idle.en: Itsumi flips through a magazine and laughs. “Hiroko always looks dependable, even on a break. ...What? I do not mention her in every conversation!”

lounge_idle.zh_CN: 愛実向坂口展示一张空白的休假计划表。「我在想下次休息日该做点什么。一直照顾别人很好，可偶尔也得给自己安排一件开心事呀。」
lounge_idle.en: Itsumi shows Sakaguchi a blank day-off planner. “I am thinking about what to do on my next day off. Taking care of people is wonderful, but I ought to plan something fun just for myself sometimes.”

rooftop_idle.zh_CN: 愛実扶着栏杆向楼下望了望。「在病房里总有人要找我，来这里可以把脑袋里的声音整理一下。……不过我也没有讨厌热闹啦。」
rooftop_idle.en: Itsumi looks down from the railing. “Someone is always calling for me in the ward. Up here I can sort out the noise in my head. ...Not that I dislike a busy place!”

rooftop_idle.zh_CN: 一阵风把愛実的发梢吹乱，她抬手理好。「有时候患者一句谢谢，比我讲十句话还管用。今天我就听到了这么一句。」
rooftop_idle.en: A gust of wind tousles Itsumi’s hair. She brushes it back. “Sometimes one little ‘thank you’ from a patient means more than ten things I could say. I heard one today.”

rooftop_idle.zh_CN: 愛実看了看天色，笑着对坂口说：「你不觉得这里很适合想事情吗？我刚刚想明白了：有时候我先别替别人回答，等她自己说完就好。」
rooftop_idle.en: Itsumi looks at the sky and smiles at Sakaguchi. “Isn’t this a good place to think? I just realized something: sometimes I should stop answering for people and let them finish.”

invitation.zh_CN: 坂口医生，下班后同路的话，要不要一起走一段？聊点工作以外的也好呀。
invitation.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, if we are going the same way after work, want to walk together? We can talk about something besides work for once.

acceptance.zh_CN: 好呀！我把手上的交接做完就来。
acceptance.en: Sure! I will finish this handover and meet you.

acceptance.zh_CN: 正好我也想出去透透气。等我拿一下东西！
acceptance.en: I was hoping to get some fresh air too. Let me grab my things!

unavailable.zh_CN: 今天还有一项护理记录要交接，恐怕不能准时走。下次再一起走吧！
unavailable.en: I still have a nursing handover to finish, so I cannot leave on time today. Let us walk together another day!

farewell.zh_CN: 今天聊得真开心。坂口医生，路上小心，明天见！
farewell.en: That was a lovely chat. Take care on your way home, Doctor Sakaguchi. See you tomorrow!

after_work_short_chat.zh_CN: 愛実拎着包笑起来：「白天一直听别人说想回家，轮到我自己下班，才发现这句话还真挺动听的。」
after_work_short_chat.en: Itsumi laughs as she picks up her bag. “I spend all day hearing people say they want to go home. Now that my own shift is over, I realize how wonderful those words sound.”

after_work_short_chat.zh_CN: 两人经过路边的小店，愛実放慢脚步。「下班后就不用一直想着工作啦。坂口医生，你平时都怎么让自己放松？」
after_work_short_chat.en: Passing a small shop, Itsumi slows down. “We do not have to think about work all evening. Doctor Sakaguchi, what do you usually do to unwind?”

after_work_short_chat.zh_CN: 愛実望着街上的灯光，轻轻呼出一口气。「照顾患者的时候我总想多说两句。现在倒想听听医生有什么好玩的事。」
after_work_short_chat.en: Itsumi looks at the streetlights and exhales. “I always want to say a little more when I am caring for patients. Right now, I would like to hear something fun from you instead.”

preop_graphic_wrapper._semantic_usage: open/insert_a/insert_b/close splice around existing full explanatory script. Do not substitute for procedure explanation or force anesthesia plan.

zh_CN.open: 「好，我把接下来的安排按顺序讲给你听。你有哪里不明白，就直接问我；别自己一个人紧张。」
zh_CN.insert_a: 「这一段听起来有点吓人吧？我知道。先把它弄明白，心里反而会有底一些。」
zh_CN.insert_b: 「你不用一直点头哦。担心什么、哪里不舒服，都可以直接说出来；需要的话我会帮你转告负责的同事。」
zh_CN.close: 「大致就是这些。还有哪一处想再听一次？我可以再慢慢讲给你听。」

en.open: All right, I will walk you through the plan step by step. If anything is unclear, just ask me. You do not have to worry about it alone.
en.insert_a: That part sounds a little frightening, does it not? I understand. Knowing what it means can make it easier to face.
en.insert_b: You do not have to keep nodding along. Tell us what worries you or feels uncomfortable. I can pass your concerns to the responsible team if needed.
en.close: That is the general outline. Is there any part you would like to hear again? I can go through it slowly with you.

implementation_notes: Four surgical nursing contexts provided; everyday spawn areas never gate OR team selection.
Crisis reported by assigned circulating nurse only and covers the existing eight monitored abnormality flavors; no hemorrhage, medical diagnosis, or gameplay hints.
Three crisis attempts means retries after failure within existing gameplay, not independent scripted medical events.
Personal nurse hints must remain 100% correct and never directly supply disease names. Wrong/right diagnosis lines occur only after player selection.
Lounge, rooftop, and everyday after-work walk are enabled by confirmed project universal rules; they are not dating unlocks.
Station and ward idle lines are supplemental for places with an enabled idle-chat implementation; do not wire to unsupported trigger API automatically.
All CN/EN work and idle text must be mapped to actual existing keys in Godot and localization; this is not a schema-validated JSON file.
Actor ID, age, skills, familiarity multiplier, and initial event scheduling are proposals until confirmed in the live project.
Original Masahiro romantic relationship and sister Natsumi in Hoshimi are unresolved; do not make a romance script that assumes she is single.
Do not materialize or invent approved character portraits or staff CG assets.
